# Three splits: two costs on one expense account, and what the company owes
# the director. `Expenses:Supplies:USD` +100.00 and +200.00 against
# `Assets:Due From Director USD` −300.00.
#
# One transaction paying two suppliers, both costs to the same account. Each
# bill claims its own split.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction, none of the splits in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies:USD
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Due From Director USD
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-03-02 * "Director paid two suppliers"
	guid: "0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0cddeeff0011"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Expenses:Supplies:USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0cddeeff00110e"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Expenses:Supplies:USD 200.00 USD
		guid: "2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0cddeeff00110e1f"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Due From Director USD -300.00 USD
		guid: "3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0cddeeff00110e1f2a"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
